players.product: data-center chillers, BASX custom air handlers & liquid-cooling packages (Redmond / Memphis)

quarterly_data.signal: In the investor presentation used at the June 2, 2026 William Blair Growth Stock Conference, AAON showed an order backlog of 2.1B (slide data based on trailing 12 months as of March 31, 2026) and a BASX backlog of 1.62B at 1Q26, up 160.0% year over year. The BASX brand sales chart (in M) shows 643.8 for the trailing 12 months as of March 31, 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: order backlog 2.1B; BASX backlog 1.62B at 1Q26 (+160.0% YoY); BASX brand sales 643.8M (TTM as of March 31, 2026)

quarterly_data.signal: The same presentation states AAON has added 1+ million sq. ft. of manufacturing capacity since 2024 with a 4x increase in data center capacity, and that BASX product offerings (computer room air handlers, air handling units, free cooling, heat rejection, chillers, coolant distribution units, fan coils) provide an end-to-end solution for data centers, with the opportunity shown as ~1.0M - 1.5M per MW.
quarterly_data.figure: 4x increase in data center capacity; BASX data center opportunity ~1.0M - 1.5M per MW
